stories.title: Bailey Hill open day to showcase Mold’s Norman castle site
stories.summary: A free open day is being held at Bailey Hill in Mold on Sunday 16 August. The event runs from 11am to 3pm at the Bailey Hill Centre on Denbigh Road, and admission is free. stories.title: Plans for padel courts in Chester FC car park given the go-ahead by Flintshire Council
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has approved plans for a padel and pickleball centre in the car park at Chester FC on Bumper’s Lane. stories.title: Funded childcare applications for Flintshire two-year-olds open on 1 September
stories.summary: Parents in Flintshire can apply for funded childcare for two-year-olds from 1 September, with places available from 2 November. stories.title: Hawarden Gladstone’s Library roof restoration enters final weeks as scaffolding removed
stories.summary: Scaffolding is being taken down at Gladstone’s Library in Hawarden after the first major repairs to the roof of the Grade I listed building.
